# Commands desktop build, graph task-worktree, and review UI updates

Patch Update cancellation uses an abort controller, `turn/interrupt` with the exact thread/turn IDs, cancellable command/build signals, a two-second acknowledgement timeout, and local-agent shutdown fallback. `cancelGraphPatchUpdateSession` must retain a cancelled dirty worktree. [Task 4]

Scope: console.
